verdict.rationale: Appwrite's documented route to data residency is self-hosting. You can run it on any Docker-capable infrastructure, the docs explicitly promise 'Full control over data location', and marketplace one-click deployments and Cloud↔self-hosted migration are documented, with a community report praising the self-hosting guide. Nothing in the evidence shows region or residency selection on the managed Appwrite Cloud, so residency requires running your own infrastructure. Missing for 10: documented region/residency choice on Appwrite Cloud, any list of available regions, independent hands-on confirmation of residency control.
